title: Project roadmap
summary: The dynamic backbone of the app: for each zone it works out the current stage from the activity log and produces the next actions, using fixed agronomy rules and safety limits, adapted to the season, the starting point and any deviations the user reports.

features.title: Next actions (rules)
features.story: As a beginner gardener, I want the app to tell me the next actions for each zone so that I always know what to do next without planning it myself.
acceptance: Given a zone with a known state, when the roadmap is recalculated, then a short list of next actions is produced, each with a reason, time window, guide link and tools needed
Safety rules are never broken (e.g. no transplanting frost-sensitive crops while there is frost risk)
Recalculation runs when a relevant activity log entry is added and once a day
Each recommendation stores the knowledge-base version that produced it
The latest next actions are shown in the app

tasks.title: Design the rules format for next actions in the knowledge base
tasks.description: Define how rules are expressed (conditions on zone state, season window, prerequisites, safety limits) and store them in content/. Done when the format is documented and validated by the content pipeline.

tasks.title: Write the first rule set for the Assess → Plant phases
tasks.description: Author rules for clearing, bed building, irrigation setup, sowing and planting out. Done when rules load without validation errors.

tasks.title: Write rules for the Maintain → Plan next season phases
tasks.description: Author rules for watering, weeding, mulching, harvest and end-of-season actions. Done when rules load without validation errors.

tasks.title: Build the rules engine that evaluates rules against zone state
tasks.description: Implement the engine that takes a zone state and date and returns candidate actions with reasons. Done when it returns expected actions for sample states.

tasks.title: Add safety limits that block unsafe actions
tasks.description: Implement hard constraints (frost risk, waterlogged soil, heat) that remove or postpone actions. Done when unit tests prove unsafe actions never appear.

tasks.title: Store next actions with traceability
tasks.description: Persist the computed next actions per zone with knowledge-base version and timestamp. Done when stored actions can be queried per zone.

tasks.title: Trigger recalculation on activity log events and daily
tasks.description: Subscribe to relevant activity log entries and add a daily scheduled job to recalculate next actions. Done when a new log entry updates next actions within a minute.

tasks.title: Expose next-actions API endpoint
tasks.description: GET endpoint returning next actions per zone with reason, window, guide link and tools. Done when documented in OpenAPI and covered by an integration test.

tasks.title: Unit tests for the rules engine with sample gardens
tasks.description: Create sample zone states (bare land, beds ready, planted) and assert the expected next actions. Done when tests pass in CI.

tasks.title: Build the next-actions list on iOS
tasks.description: Show next actions per zone with reason, time window and links to guide and tools. Done when the list renders from the API on device.

tasks.title: API unit tests for Next actions (rules)
tasks.description: Unit tests for the domain logic and rules of this feature. Done when they run in the pipeline and cover the main cases.

tasks.title: API integration tests for Next actions (rules)
tasks.description: Endpoint tests against the database containers, including user scoping. Done when they run in the pipeline.

tasks.title: iOS unit tests for Next actions (rules)
tasks.description: Unit tests for the view models and formatting of this feature. Done when they run in the pipeline.

tasks.title: iOS UI tests for Next actions (rules)
tasks.description: XCUITest flows for the screens of this feature against the fake API. Done when they run in the pipeline.

tasks.title: Test next actions on iPhone against the real plot
tasks.description: Enter the real plot's state and check the next actions make sense. Done when issues found are logged as bugs.

features.title: Next actions (AI)
features.story: As a gardener, I want the AI to rank and adapt my next actions and explain why so that the advice fits my exact situation.
acceptance: AI ranks the rule-based candidate actions for each zone
Deviations are handled with adapted alternatives
Each action has a plain-language explanation
Safety limits from the rules layer are never overridden

acceptance: Each zone shows its current phase (Assess, Design, Prepare soil, Irrigation, Plant, Maintain, Harvest, Plan next season)
The phase is worked out from the zone's state, not stored as a pointer
The zone state view is rebuilt from the activity log
Changing one zone's state does not affect other zones

title: Site assessment
summary: The AI looks at photos of each zone to work out what's there now, what needs clearing or fixing and how much effort it will take, with no soil analysis. Results feed the roadmap engine.

features.title: AI photo assessment
features.story: As a beginner, I want to photograph each zone and have the AI tell me what needs clearing or fixing so that I know where to start.
acceptance: The user takes one or more photos of a zone
The AI reports vegetation to clear (with method, time and cost), problem plants, trees to keep, obstacles, terrain, visible water problems and infrastructure
Each finding has a confidence level
No soil analysis is attempted
The assessment is saved and recorded in the activity log so the roadmap updates
